name: SHIBUYA SKY
intro: An open-air observation deck on the roof of Shibuya Scramble Square, right above Shibuya Crossing. Entry is by time slot, and slots around sunset sell out first.
statusNote: Release timing from a third-party planner; official site not yet checked. Note: shibuya-sky.com is NOT the official site.
popularityNote: Keyword data (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026): "shibuya sky tickets" about 500,000 searches a month, the highest of any place we list.
difficultyNote: Estimate: sunset slots sell out days ahead; other times are often still available nearer the day.
bookingSteps: Open the official SHIBUYA SKY site and use its ticket link. The LANG menu switches the language.
Choose a date and an entry time. Sunset slots sell out first, so book those as soon as sales open.
On the day, put your bags in a locker before you go up: bags aren't allowed on the rooftop.
Check the opening status on the official site before you go. The open-air rooftop can close in bad weather.
visitorTips: The domain shibuya-sky.com is not the official site.
Opening hours are 10:00 to 22:30, with last entry at 21:20.
Tickets are sold on the day only if any are left.

faq.q: When do SHIBUYA SKY tickets go on sale?
faq.a: Standard web tickets are reported to go on sale at midnight Japan time, two weeks before the visit date. Check the official site to confirm.

sources.quote: Standard web tickets release at 00:00 JST two weeks before admission
